title: Review of the crawler re-nucleation claim on fresh seeds 6-8: re-nucleation through a non-polar disk replicates on seed 6 (labkit), but only 1 of 4 fresh realizations takes that path (2 competition, 1 death). With the noise off, the cut cell stays a static, uniformly polarized disk: the new front is noise-driven symmetry breaking
summary: 40% front cut at t=8 (WORLD_P cut_t 8, cut_mode front, cut_frac 0.4), labkit packs of world.py on fresh seeds 6, 7 and 8 (frames 100, t=20), classified with the claim's classify.py (classify.txt). Seed 6: a non-polar disk at t=9.0-9.8 (|d| down to 0.001). Then a new front forms by t~11.4, and the cell crawls on a new heading (downward, against rightward before the cut) for 3.4 body lengths in the run (packs/front40_seed6/sheet.png), final |d| 0.158. Seeds 7 and 8: no non-polar phase (min |d| 0.100 and 0.106). These take the parent claim's competition path and crawl on (4.1 and 3.7 body lengths). Side-by-side run on seed 6 with its twin (the claim's cutrun.py, whose post-cut noise stream differs from the labkit run): the cut removes 38% of the area and 45% of the protein, and the cut cell dies at t=8.96 while the twin crawls on at 0.421 (cuts/s6_front0.4). Same cut with the noise off (eta=0, cuts/s6_front0.4_eta0): the cell becomes a uniformly polarized round disk, swells back to area 2.15 (twin 2.64) and never moves (speed 0 from t~9.3 to 20). Re-nucleation needs noise to break the symmetric high state, and its outcome depends on the noise realization.

observations.M: packs/front40_seed6-8 FACTS: 3.4-4.1 body lengths per run, crawling before and after the cut
observations.R: packs/front40_seed6/sheet.png and classify.txt: non-polar disk t=9.0-9.8 (|d| 0.001), new front by t~11.4, crawls on a new heading

seeds_run.result: fail (side-by-side cutrun, different post-cut noise: the cut cell dies at t=8.96)

controls_run.R: cuts/s6_front0.4 (branched undamaged twin crawls on at 0.421); cuts/s6_front0.4_eta0 (noise off: static uniformly polarized disk, no re-nucleation)

verdicts.limitation: The re-nucleation path occurred in 1 of 4 fresh realizations (the claim: 3/5 labkit, 2/3 side-by-side). The others took the competition path (2) or died (1). The outcome depends on the post-cut noise stream even for the same seed. Without noise the non-polar disk never re-polarizes, so the new front is noise-driven symmetry breaking of the swollen high state. The cell keeps only the protein it was left with: area returns to ~0.8 of the twin's in the no-noise disk and less in crawling remnants.
